MowerState.description:
A telemetry snapshot of one mower, published on ``telemetry.mower.<id>``.

Two times: ``observed_at`` is when the mower reported the values, ``heartbeat_at`` when the
gateway's link to it was last alive. A docked mower reports rarely, so old values do not mean
an offline mower (ADR 0040).

base_station.description: The RTK base station the mower is linked to in Fleet, as the mower's connection sees it (correction link, satellites, position, firmware; ADR 0047); null for a mower without a linked base station.

connected.description: False in the state the Device-Gateway publishes right after its connection to the mower ended: the last known values, with `heartbeat_at` the last time the link was alive. Set by the gateway, never by an adapter.
connected.title: Connected

drive_calibration.description: The drive calibration MowDeck runs on this mower (`DriveCalibrate`, ADR 0042), with its final state and result kept until the next one; null when there never was one.

drive_recoverable.description: With activity `error`: the error is not a safety sensor stop, so manual driving may free the mower (stuck, wheel slip). Lift, tilt and collision stops are never drive recoverable; the controller refuses drive frames for them.
drive_recoverable.title: Drive Recoverable

drive_speed_mps.description: The vendor's speed setting for manual driving (`MowerCapabilities.drive_speed_setting`); null when the connection has none or has not read it yet.
drive_speed_mps.title: Drive Speed Mps

error_category.description: With activity `error`: the manufacturer-neutral kind of the fault; null otherwise or when the connection cannot tell.

firmware_info.description: Installed and available firmware and the update state; null when the adapter has not checked (or cannot check) the vendor.

gnss.description: Satellite positioning details (satellites, RTK correction age, solution); null when the connection does not report them.

heartbeat_at.description: When the Device-Gateway last knew its connection to the mower alive (UTC). The gateway sets it on every publish, never an adapter: it advances with each heartbeat while `observed_at` stays the time of the mower's last report. Clients judge online and offline by it (ADR 0040); null in states from before the field, then `observed_at` stands in.
heartbeat_at.title: Heartbeat At

job.description: The mowing job the mower runs (progress, current area, elapsed and remaining seconds, mowed square metres); null when none runs or the connection does not report it.

light_on.description: Whether the mower's light (the camera's headlamp) is on, as the mower reports it; null when not reported (no light, or no answer yet).
light_on.title: Light On

links.description: State of the mower's additional links by kind (e.g. `ble_bridge`); empty for a mower with only its primary connection.

observed_at.description: When the device reported this state (UTC).
observed_at.title: Observed At

settings.title: Settings

NetworkKind.description:
How the mower itself reaches the internet (its own uplink, not MowDeck's connection to

ObstacleDetection.description:
How eagerly the mower avoids obstacles during a native job (``MowPattern``).

Which modes a mower offers depends on its model and firmware
(``MowerCapabilities.start_options.obstacle_detection``). The names follow the vendor apps:
``off`` is the plain bump-and-turn behaviour, ``standard`` avoids obstacles it sees ahead,
``sensitive`` additionally avoids areas that are not lawn; ``slow_touch`` and
``less_touch`` exist only on older firmware.
ObstacleDetection.title: ObstacleDetection

PathOrder.description: Whether the border laps run before or after the fill of a native job.

PermissionDef.description:
A permission a module defines, e.g. ``mower.control``.

Keys that have a relation in the authorization model are checked per object in OpenFGA.
Other keys are coarse, account-wide permissions carried in the access token (``perms``) and
checked with ``require_permission``. ``implied_by`` lets such a key follow an existing one:
whoever holds every listed key on the whole account also holds this key.

implied_by.description: Keys that imply this one when held on the whole account (e.g. `device_gateway.view` implied by `mower.view`).
implied_by.title: Implied By

PermissionDef.title: PermissionDef

PositionSource.description:
Where :attr:`MowerState.position` comes from, so consumers can judge it.

``rtk`` is the mower's own positioning with an RTK fix (fixed or float), ``gnss`` the same
positioning without an RTK fix (single point, metres of scatter), ``dock`` the known pose of
the charging station while the mower stands in it (the adapter reports the dock instead of
the scattering raw position), ``unknown`` when there is no position or its quality is not
known.

StartOptions.description:
The job options a native start may carry besides the pattern (``MowPattern``), as one
mower declares them (ADR 0030 amendment of 2026-10-24).

Everything defaults to "not offered": a client shows an option only when it is declared
here, and the connection refuses a start that sets an option it does not declare. An option
a start leaves out (None) is not sent, so the mower keeps its own default.

obstacle_detection.description: Obstacle detection modes the mower offers, in the order a client shows them (`MowPattern.obstacle_detection`); empty when it offers no choice.
obstacle_detection.title: Obstacle Detection

obstacle_laps_range.description: Inclusive (min, max) laps around each no-go zone (`MowPattern.obstacle_laps`), if settable.
obstacle_laps_range.title: Obstacle Laps Range

orders.description: Path orders the mower offers (`MowPattern.order`); empty when it offers no choice.
orders.title: Orders

start_progress_range_pct.description: Inclusive (min, max) progress in percent a job may start at (`MowPattern.start_progress_pct`), if settable.
start_progress_range_pct.title: Start Progress Range Pct

StartOptions.title: StartOptions

StartPlan.description:
One way to start a mower that has no map areas to choose (ADR 0066 amendment).

A mower whose connection knows no area geometry (its vendor keeps the garden to itself)
cannot be started by tapping areas. Its connection declares the starts it offers instead; a
client sends ``StartMow {plan_ref: ref}`` for the one the user picks and labels it by
``kind`` (plus ``name`` for a zone).

name.description: The mower's own name of a zone, shown as is; null for the other kinds.
name.title: Name

StartPlan.title: StartPlan

TurnStyle.description:
How a spot run turns at the end of a lane (ADR 0043).

``in_place``: the mower rotates on the spot (fast, but an all-wheel-drive mower scuffs the
turf). ``arc``: a forward U-turn with a radius of at least half the lane spacing, or a bulb
turn over the neighbouring lane when the spacing is narrower than the turning radius.
``multi_point``: a three-point turn (forward arc, reverse arc with the blades off, forward
arc); needs a drive link that can reverse (``MowerCapabilities.drive_reverse``).
TurnStyle.title: TurnStyle

get.description:
Health totals: blade and mowing hours, distance, battery cycles, charge sessions and
errors since the first state; 404 ``no-telemetry-yet`` when nothing was recorded.
Recorded blade changes, newest first (at most 100).

post.description:
Record a blade change: the blade hours since the change restart at zero and the
threshold reminder is armed again. Works before the first telemetry, too.

put.description:
Set the mower's blade reminder threshold in hours (``can_manage_mowers``, like the blade
reset); ``null`` drops it, so the mower follows its own warning again
(``device_blade_warn_hours``) when it reports one, else the default
(``MOWDECK_TELEMETRY_BLADE_HOURS_THRESHOLD``); ``blade_hours_threshold_effective`` names the
threshold in effect. The reminder is armed again when the blade hours shown lie below the
new effective threshold. Works before the first telemetry, too. The warning stored on the
mower itself is not changed.

get.description: Health totals per UTC day (default: the last 30 days, at most 366).

A raster layer over the mower's map frame for a time range (default: the last 7 days):
cut share and missed areas (``coverage``), share of fixed RTK samples (``rtk``) or median
signal in dBm (``wifi``, ``mnet``). 404 ``no-map-yet`` before the gateway published a map.

State history; with ``step`` one point per bin (last activity and RTK fix, battery mean
and range, charging if any, last position).

parameters.description: Bin width such as 5s, 1m, 1h or 1d (date_bin); raw rows without.
parameters.name: step

get.description:

The ETag is the map revision, so a client can revalidate with ``If-None-Match``.

progress along it, as the Device-Gateway last published it; 404 ``no-path`` without a job
or before the route arrived. Clients poll it while the mower works.

404.description: `no-path`: no running job whose route is known.

get.description:
A compact state for the iOS widgets and the Live Activity (ADR 0059): activity (`offline`
when stale), battery, rain sensor, error (code, vendor message and, from the error lexicon,
title, category and severity, ADR 0067) and the job with progress, area name and remaining
time. 404 "no telemetry yet" before the first state.

get.description:
A PNG of the mower's map for the iOS map widget (ADR 0059): areas, no-go zones, the mowed
path (the mow path up to its progress, else the last 3 hours of the track), the dock and the
mower. Bounded in size, cached for 30 seconds and drawn at most twice at a time. 404
`no-map-yet` before the gateway published a map.

503.description: All drawing slots are taken; retry in a few seconds.

post.description:
One base map tile for the page of a share link, only around the shared track. No
login; 404 for any unusable token or a tile away from the track, 429 when asked too
often.

The live page of a share link: the position, the track since the alarm, the times and
the mower's name and model. No login; 404 for any unusable token, 429 when asked too
often.

get.description:
Day totals (UTC days, default the last 30, at most 366) of every mower of the caller's
account that the caller may view, in one call: blade and mowing hours, distance, jobs,
online hours, battery cycles, charge sessions and errors by code. Mowers without data in
the range are absent; Telemetry does not know sites, so clients filter by Fleet's
``site_id`` (or pass ``mower_id``).

parameters.description: Only these mowers (repeatable); invisible ones are left out silently.
parameters.name: mower_id
